fault_artifact: Testing only, MUST NOT deploy; explicit fault hash in RELEASE_MANIFEST
assumptions: Protocol 88/storage price and bounded gas/input envelope
128 pre-funded 512-byte admission slots; unknown refunds may permanently consume capacity
All funded native liabilities and stake coverage must reconcile at finalized checkpoints
FullAccess custody permits arbitrary replacement; caps are conditional on unchanged code
Guardian stop irreversible, only new risk blocked; existing rights remain
No permissionless proof of genuinely unknown transfer outcome

payout_state_machine.available: withdraw moves funded claim to InFlight, transfer plus callback
payout_state_machine.success: Matching callback releases inflight and marks paid
payout_state_machine.failure: Known failure is retryable only with required+inflight local liquidity
payout_state_machine.lost_callback: Unknown remains InFlight; no resend; admin cannot mark successful/failed
payout_state_machine.storage_refund: Per-user funded refund with pre-reserved record; pending/unregistration state cleared only by matching known completion

reproduction.fault: Same command with --features contract,fault-injection; never overwrite preserved normal artifact
reproduction.runtime: Start disposable local near-sandbox 2.14.0; use runtime/test.mjs and bounded auxiliary harnesses with SANDBOX_RPC localhost, frozen normal/fault paths and explicit fixture SANDBOX_PILOT_LIMITS. Sandbox-only credentials must be newly disposable, never production keys.
